title: Figure 1 Panel A Statistics Digest (FR-043 family)
description: JSON file written at `figures/architecture/panel-a-stats/stats.json`. Carries the five-section headline counts (Entities, Metabolite-Protein Interactions, Interactions, Structures, Annotation) plus per-section contributing-resource counts that back the numbers the author hand-transcribes into the manually-authored Panel A diagram. The digest is bound to the same snapshot identifier as Figure 1's other artifacts (FR-043h) and its provenance lives in the sibling `stats.provenance.json`. Added 2026-06-14.

metadata.description: Top-level provenance + binding block. Replicates the snapshot identifier(s) and deployments so a reader of `stats.json` alone can audit the digest without opening the sidecar.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bump on any incompatible change to the digest's structure.

produced_at.description: Timestamp when this digest was written. EXCLUDED from any byte-identical comparison between rebuilds.

name.description: Deployment label. Post-2026-06-14 dev5 integrated-build promotion: `dev5` is the only active rotation deployment, carrying all five sections (FR-043h). `dev3` and `dev4` remain valid enum values for historical-sidecar compatibility with pre-promotion rebuilds.

section_ids.description: Section numbers this deployment served. Together the two `section_ids` arrays MUST cover {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}.

snapshot_ids.description: Map `{ build → snapshot_id }` for every build touched. MUST equal the Figure 1 composite's `snapshot_ids` in the same rebuild. A mismatch fails the rebuild (FR-043h, SC-012).

script_path.description: Path to the digest builder relative to repo root (typically `R/stats/panel_a_digest.R`).

script_commit.description: Full git commit hash of the digest builder at rebuild time.

definitions.description: The exact definition variant chosen by the digest where FR-043 allows alternatives. Mirrors `digest-config.yaml` at rebuild time so a reader can trace the variant back to the config revision.

resources.description: Curated `data_source.name` list used to identify transporter proteins (default `[tcdb, slctables]`).

Curated `data_source.name` list used to identify receptor proteins (default `[guidetopharma, connectomedb, cellphonedb]`). The cycle-001 predicate vocabulary collapses `Ligand-receptor` into `Other` so `interaction_class_id` is not a sufficient signal.

pathway.description: Which definition fired for Section 3's pathway count. Preferred is `Pathway:OM:0014` (distinct pathway entities with ≥ 1 member protein/gene participating in an interaction); fallback `annotation` switches to pathway-annotation lookup when the preferred branch returns fewer than the configured minimum.

reaction.description: Which definition fired for Section 3's reaction count.

annotation_slot3.description: The annotation category that occupied Section 5 slot 3. Default `diseases`; falls back deterministically per FR-043e when the disease row count is below the configured threshold.

sections.description: Five sections in fixed order — Entities, Metabolite-Protein Interactions, Interactions, Structures, Annotation.

resource_count.description: Number of distinct `data_source.name` values contributing ≥ 1 row to this section's underlying join (FR-043f).

resources.description: The explicit per-section resource list (FR-043f) so the author can cross-check which resources back each headline number.

metric_name.description: Stable identifier — e.g. `n_metabolites`, `n_proteins_or_genes`, `n_transporters`, `n_receptors`, `n_mpi_relations`, `n_interactions`, `n_pathways`, `n_reactions`, `n_structures_total`, `n_structures_stereospecific`, `n_constitutional_skeletons`, `n_full_inchikey`, `n_ramp_conflicts`, `n_annotation_records`, `n_organisms`, `n_diseases`, `n_localizations`, `n_pathways_annotation`. Names are case-insensitive but kebab/snake casing MUST be consistent within a digest.

definition_label.description: Names the definition variant chosen — e.g. `transporter:tcdb+slctables+uniprot_kw`, `receptor:guidetopharma+connectomedb+cellphonedb+uniprot_kw`, `pathway:Pathway:OM:0014`, `reaction:Reaction:OM:0015`. Mirrors `metadata.definitions` so each metric stands alone.

state.description: `populated` for normal metrics; `empty` for known-empty buckets like `xenobiotic` on current builds; `fallback` for Section 5 slot 3 when the disease threshold triggered the chain.

sql_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonicalised SQL text that produced this metric. The verbatim SQL is stored in the digest sidecar (`stats.provenance.json → queries`); this hash lets a reader of `stats.json` alone verify the query without opening the sidecar.
